title.zh-CN: 水肿深色尿与溶血 · 7岁女孩
title.en: Oedema, dark urine and haemolysis · girl aged 7

summary.zh-CN: 溶血、低血小板和严重肾损伤需进一步区分TMA病因，避免仅以有无腹泻分类。
summary.en: Haemolysis, thrombocytopenia and severe renal injury require TMA aetiology assessment beyond diarrhoea history.

provenance.citation: 刘晓宇, 管娜, 姚勇. 抗H因子自身抗体相关性溶血尿毒综合征一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2012;50(04):313-314. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2012.04.019.

notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 组合溶血、血小板减少和肾损伤识别TMA。
learningOutcomes.en: Combine haemolysis, thrombocytopenia and renal injury to recognise TMA.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释补体和ADAMTS13证据的不同作用。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain the differing roles of complement and ADAMTS13 evidence.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分器官恢复与持续抗体。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish organ recovery from persistent antibody activity.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 持续监测高血压神经风险和补体活动，避免血象改善后的过早停访
learningOutcomes.en: Monitor hypertensive neurological risk and complement activity beyond count recovery

chiefComplaint.en: Thirty days of oedema and cola-coloured urine

prompt.zh-CN: 这种肾脏为主的TMA应如何进一步鉴别？
prompt.en: How should this renal-predominant TMA be differentiated?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 评估补体相关HUS、感染相关HUS及其他TMA
text.en: Assess complement-associated HUS, infection-associated HUS and other TMAs

feedback.zh-CN: 腹泻阴性并不能替代病原及补体证据。
feedback.en: Absent diarrhoea does not replace pathogen and complement evidence.

text.zh-CN: 既往皮肤紫癜已确定这次所有肾损害病因
text.en: Previous cutaneous purpura establishes the current renal cause

feedback.zh-CN: 严重微血管性溶血和血小板减少需独立解释。
feedback.en: Severe microangiopathic haemolysis and thrombocytopenia need separate explanation.

text.zh-CN: 高血压足以停止所有TMA病因检查
text.en: Hypertension ends all TMA aetiology assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 高压可参与也可继发于TMA，需要双向评估。
feedback.en: Hypertension may contribute to or result from TMA.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 抗H抗体支持免疫介导补体机制，定性结果和遗传信息仍有限
text.en: Anti-factor-H positivity supports an immune complement mechanism, with limited titre/genetic data

feedback.zh-CN: 正常ADAMTS13不支持严重缺乏型TTP，但不完成所有病因排除。
feedback.en: Normal ADAMTS13 argues against severe-deficiency TTP without excluding every other cause.

text.zh-CN: 低C3单项即可确诊抗H抗体病
text.en: Low C3 alone diagnoses anti-factor-H disease

feedback.en: Antibody and clinical evidence are needed.

text.zh-CN: 普通便培养阴性彻底排除STEC
text.en: Routine negative stool culture fully excludes STEC

feedback.en: Specific toxin testing was not detailed.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何组织急性和长期管理？
prompt.en: How should acute and long-term management be organised?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 肾脏血液团队处理肾替代、血压与神经风险，复核抗体并讨论当前补体/免疫治疗
text.en: Renal/haematology teams should manage renal support, BP and neurological risk, repeat antibodies and consider current complement/immune therapies

feedback.zh-CN: 旧报道疗法和血压水平不直接作为今日目标。
feedback.en: Historical therapy and achieved BP are not automatically current targets.

text.zh-CN: 血常规恢复就永久停止随访

feedback.zh-CN: 抗体及器官风险可以持续。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：组合溶血、血小板减少和肾损伤识别TMA。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：抗体滴度、补体遗传、Shiga毒素检测及更长肾神经结局。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Combine haemolysis, thrombocytopenia and renal injury to recognise TMA. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Antibody titre, complement genetics, Shiga-toxin testing and longer renal/neurological outcome. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 抗H因子抗体相关HUS的证据较强，血液和肾脏恢复不等于免疫学缓解。
conclusion.en: Evidence supports anti-factor-H-associated HUS; haematological/renal recovery is not immunological remission.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 解释补体和ADAMTS13证据的不同作用。
teachingPoints.en: Explain the differing roles of complement and ADAMTS13 evidence.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 区分器官恢复与持续抗体。
teachingPoints.en: Distinguish organ recovery from persistent antibody activity.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 抗体滴度、补体遗传、Shiga毒素检测及更长肾神经结局。
unknowns.en: Antibody titre, complement genetics, Shiga-toxin testing and longer renal/neurological outcome.

references: 刘晓宇, 管娜, 姚勇. 抗H因子自身抗体相关性溶血尿毒综合征一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2012;50(04):313-314. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2012.04.019.

testUtterances.text: 眼睛肿和尿色变深什么时候开始？
When did eyelid swelling and dark urine begin?
最初尿是什么颜色？
What colour was the urine initially?
每天尿量大约多少，后来更少了吗？
How much urine is passed daily, and has it decreased further?
最近有没有明显少尿？
Has urine output become markedly reduced?
发病前有没有腹泻或呕吐？
Was there diarrhoea or vomiting before the illness?
肠胃不舒服先持续了多久？
How long did the preceding stomach symptoms last?
之前做过透析或血浆治疗吗，哪里改善了？
Was dialysis or plasma treatment given, and what improved?
水肿退了以后尿量恢复了吗？
Did urine output recover when oedema improved?
以前有没有出现紫癜？
Was there previous purpura?
那次皮肤紫癜时尿检怎样？
What did urine tests show during the earlier purpura?
家里有人有类似疾病或遗传病吗？
Does anyone in the family have similar or inherited illness?
父母和兄弟姐妹健康情况怎样？
How is the health of parents and siblings?
现在还会反复腹胀呕吐吗？
Do distension and vomiting continue to recur?

Did gastrointestinal decompression relieve symptoms?

以前有没有既往手术方面的情况？
Could you describe any earlier operations?

Could you describe any regular medicines?
